latin: Sicut intelligibiles dei uniformiter omnia producunt, ita intelligibiles intellectualesque trinaliter, intellectuales autem ebdomatice.
translation: Just as the intelligible gods produce all things uniformly, so the intelligible-and-intellectual gods produce them in a threefold way, and the intellectual gods in a sevenfold way.
